reason: 0.5.45 ships the trajectory that pays a Stripe-hosted checkout with the workspace card, because Stripe refuses raw card numbers over its API and a hosted session can only be completed in a browser; it also makes two purchase paths portable across hosts - one loader finds the card whether the host keeps it under ~/.weles or ~/.stado, and the placement guard every session passes through resolves the Stado binary under .stado/bin as well as .local/bin, which is why every browser trajectory on the always-on mini died with 'cannot verify Weles placement through Stado'. CLI and library surface are unchanged.
